purpose: E1 single-defect intervention CPU variants (G1). NO GPU run, NO model inference, NO test scoring.

baseline.name: legacy_bundle
baseline.note: Common baseline for all single-defect variants; copied verbatim (byte-identical).

fully_repaired_source.name: fully_repaired
fully_repaired_source.note: v2.1 fully repaired (M1/M2/M3). DIFFERENT generator commit and RNG stream than legacy; per-row sample_hash differs on all rows. Treated as VERSION DIFFERENCE, not a pure single-defect effect.

serialization: json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False) + LF, trailing LF; SHA-256 over file bytes (canonical LF, no CR)

dedup_only.scope: TRAIN only; VAL verbatim; declared as IN-TRAIN DEDUP (NOT train-val overlap cleanup)
dedup_only.rule: remove train rows whose (context_A,context_B,query,edited_span) duplicates an earlier row in the SAME train split; keep first occurrence by file order

degenerate_only.rule: remove rows with must_flip==true AND candidate_A==candidate_B (M1 defect); F5 same-candidate pairs with must_flip==false are BY DESIGN and retained
degenerate_only.caveat: label/task-validity defect; these rows do NOT enter ridge supervised fitting in canonical pipeline; no causal effect on mapper fitting is claimed

entity_disjoint_only.rule: replace every entity string (name/project/city/date/number) occurring in val text with an injective, rule-generated disjoint substitute absent from train text, applied consistently across context_A/context_B/query/candidate_A/candidate_B/edited_span; recompute sample_hash & sample_id; row count and template_family labels unchanged
entity_disjoint_only.synthetic_note: disjoint substitutes are rule-generated by this prep script, NOT emitted by the original generator

template_disjoint_only.changed_attribute: query skeleton overlap across train/val only
template_disjoint_only.rule: rewrite each val query into a structurally different skeleton (6 deterministic paraphrase rules); context documents and correctness labels unchanged; recompute sample_hash & sample_id; row count and template_family labels unchanged
template_disjoint_only.caveat: query input text changes -> counts as a DATA-TASK change requiring GPU forward if used for Panel B; CPU replay on original logits is NOT valid for this variant

fully_repaired.rule: verbatim copy of fixed generator train/val
fully_repaired.caveat: different commit/RNG than legacy -> VERSION DIFFERENCE

flags.dedup_definition: IN-TRAIN DEDUP only; train-val overlap cleanup NOT applied in dedup_only; the two are deliberately not conflated.
flags.degenerate_definition: label/task-validity defect; excluded from ridge supervised fitting; no causal claim on mapper fitting.
flags.composition_rule: any row-count or family-count change is flagged as a VERSION DIFFERENCE, not a pure single-defect effect.
flags.fully_repaired: separate generator commit/RNG -> version difference; do not read as a clean one-attribute A/B vs legacy.
flags.no_test_access: E2 test split not read for content, not scored, no predictions written.

verification_script.purpose: Re-verify all 36 file hashes/counts/family counts and recompute every single-defect rule against data/audit_2x2 sources. No GPU, no model inference, no test scoring.
